NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 13, 11:14 AM ET

Kenneth Walker III is the top-projected running back on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 25.3 DraftKings points for $8,500, against the Chargers. Bijan Robinson (25.0, $8,700) and Kyren Williams (24.4, $6,800) are next.

Kyren Williams returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.59 projected points per $1,000 at $6,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 13, 11:14 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 6

Kenneth Walker III, KC vs LAC ($8,500)

Kenneth Walker III carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 25.3 DraftKings points at $8,500, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.2 points clear of Bijan Robinson. The model gives him 20.1 carries and 4.2 targets. The salary works out to 2.97 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 25.2 points with a simulated floor of 13.0 and a ceiling of 41.5, and he holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is an 8.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs CHI ($8,700)

Bijan Robinson projects 2nd at the position with 25.0 DraftKings points at $8,700, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 17.2 carries and 5.0 targets. The salary works out to 2.88 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 24.9 points with a simulated floor of 13.2 and a ceiling of 40.5, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 3-point underdog at home against Chicago, with an implied team total of 23.25 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Kyren Williams, LAR vs ARI ($6,800)

Kyren Williams projects 3rd at the position with 24.4 DraftKings points at $6,800, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 17.9 carries and 4.4 targets. The salary works out to 3.59 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 24.5 points with a simulated floor of 12.8 and a ceiling of 40.6, and he holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32.5 in a game totaled at 52.5.

Value: Bucky Irving, TB vs PIT ($6,200)

Bucky Irving projects for 14.4 DraftKings points at $6,200, which works out to 2.33 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 12.8 carries and 3.5 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Irving averaged 14.4 points with a simulated floor of 4.7 and a ceiling of 29.1, and he holds 3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tampa Bay is a 3-point underdog at home against Pittsburgh, with an implied team total of 18.75 in a game totaled at 40.5.
